client.name: Synthetic Demo Lender
client.description: A synthetic UK equity release lender used throughout the Trakt demonstration materials. Its book is a lifetime-mortgage portfolio with interest roll-up, funded through a warehouse facility and reported to ESMA Annex 2 for securitisation.

provenance.note: Every value in this pack was produced by the Trakt deterministic MI engine from the repository's synthetic canonical dataset. The landing page performs no portfolio calculation of its own.

intents.label: What is the current funded portfolio balance?
intents.answer: The funded book stands at £5.4MM across 36 exposures as at 30 November 2025. The figure is the sum of current outstanding balance on the governed canonical dataset — the same calculation the MI workspace and Microsoft 365 Copilot return for this portfolio.
intents.interpreted: Chart: Summary (no chart) · Metric: Balance · Aggregation: Sum · Parser: deterministic · Validation: Passed

intents.label: How many loans are in the funded book?
intents.answer: There are 36 exposures in the funded book as at 30 November 2025, carrying £5,382,463 of current outstanding balance.
intents.interpreted: Chart: Summary (no chart) · Aggregation: Count · Parser: deterministic · Validation: Passed

intents.label: What is the weighted average current LTV?
intents.answer: Weighted average current LTV is 43.5% as at 30 November 2025, balance-weighted across the funded book. Current LTV is derived from current outstanding balance over current valuation amount by the governed canonical transform, not restated here.
intents.interpreted: Chart: Summary (no chart) · Metric: Current LTV · Aggregation: Weighted average · Parser: deterministic · Validation: Passed

intents.label: What is the weighted average interest rate?
intents.answer: Weighted average interest rate is 7.6% as at 30 November 2025, balance-weighted across the funded book.
intents.interpreted: Chart: Summary (no chart) · Metric: Interest Rate · Aggregation: Weighted average · Parser: deterministic · Validation: Passed

intents.label: Which regions have the highest exposure?
phrases: which regions have the highest exposure
intents.answer: East Midlands is the largest regional exposure at £830,812 (15.4% of the funded book), ahead of East of England at £760,587. Regions are derived from property postcode via the ITL/NUTS lookup in the governed transform, so the split is reproducible from source.
intents.interpreted: Chart: Bar · Metric: Balance · Dimension: Region · Aggregation: Sum · Parser: deterministic · Validation: Passed

intents.label: Show the portfolio by LTV band.
phrases: show the portfolio by ltv band
intents.answer: The book is concentrated in the 50-60% band, which holds £1,774,558 (33.0%). LTV bands are the governed bucket definitions from the shared analytics library, so the same bands appear in the investor pack and the regulatory stratifications.
intents.interpreted: Chart: Bar · Metric: Balance · Dimension: LTV Bucket · Aggregation: Sum · Parser: deterministic · Validation: Passed

intents.label: Show the portfolio by borrower age band.
intents.answer: The largest age cohort is 80-85, holding £1,673,675 (31.1%) of the funded book. Borrower age drives redemption expectations on an equity release book, so it is a standing stratification in both investor and management reporting.
intents.interpreted: Chart: Bar · Metric: Balance · Dimension: Age Bucket · Aggregation: Sum · Parser: deterministic · Validation: Passed

intents.answer: IFA is the largest origination channel at £2,102,228 (39.1%) of the funded book.

intents.label: What are the principal portfolio risks?
intents.answer: The material concentrations as at 30 November 2025 are region (East Midlands at 15.4%); ltv band (50-60% at 33.0%); borrower age band (80-85 at 31.1%). Nothing in this synthetic book breaches a limit, because no limit set is configured for the public demonstration — in a client environment these same measures are evaluated against the portfolio's own covenant and concentration limits, and breaches raise governed alerts.
intents.interpreted: Concentration analysis · Region, LTV band, borrower age band

intents.label: How do I know these numbers are right?
phrases: how do i know these numbers are right
where does the data come from
intents.answer: Every figure on this page traces back through the same gated pipeline. For the 30 November 2025 cut, 62 source headers were mapped to canonical fields (60 at full confidence), the typed transform recorded 0 parse failures, validation raised 2 field-level exception(s) — both enumeration mismatches, held open rather than silently corrected — and the ESMA Annex 2 delivery preflight passed with 0 issues. The exceptions are real, and Trakt reports them rather than resolving them for you.
intents.interpreted: Governance evidence · pipeline gate reports for this run

unsupported.label: How has the portfolio changed since last month?
unsupported.reason: Temporal comparison needs two governed reporting periods. The public demonstration publishes a single snapshot (30 November 2025), so there is no prior period to compare against and Trakt will not estimate one.
unsupported.productionNote: In a client environment, Trakt holds a governed snapshot history and answers month-on-month, quarter-on-quarter and since-inception movement, with a reconciliation of every driver of the change.

unsupported.label: Summarise the current pipeline.
unsupported.reason: Pipeline analytics run on an application-stage dataset. The public demonstration publishes only the funded loan tape, so there is no pipeline to summarise.
unsupported.productionNote: In a client environment, Trakt runs pipeline snapshots, the origination funnel, conversion analysis and expected-funding forecasts alongside the funded book.

unsupported.label: What are the arrears and default figures?
unsupported.reason: This synthetic equity release book carries no arrears or default balances, so an arrears answer would be meaningless rather than merely empty.
unsupported.productionNote: Arrears, default, forbearance and loss analytics are standard Trakt portfolio analytics where the portfolio's own data supports them.

unsupported.label: Show me individual loan records.
unsupported.reason: The public demonstration returns aggregated portfolio measures only. Exposure-level records are never exposed on this page, even for synthetic data.
unsupported.productionNote: Exposure-level drill-through exists in the Trakt workspace, governed by role-based access within the client environment.
